question: A freely suspended magnet always aligns in the ______ direction.
solution:
The correct answer is__** north-south.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A freely suspended bar magnet always aligns itself in the **North-South** direction.
 
• The magnetic north pole of the earth attracts the south pole of a magnet.
 
• The tip which points to the geographic North has known as the **North pole** and the tip which points to the geographic South is known as the South pole** of the magnet.**
 
• A magnet is an object that creates a magnetic field:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​The magnetic field is invisible,** but it's responsible for the most obvious property of a magnet.
 
• The ability to attract some materials, like **iron, and attract or repel other magnets.**
 
• Magnets, hang through a string, always point towards the **north-south direction.**
